For a gambler's ruin with up-probability p=2/3 and down-probability q=1/3, the ratio r = q/p = 1/2.

The probability of reaching N before 0 starting from position i is:

P(i) = (1 - r^i) / (1 - r^N)

with N = 6, r = 1/2, and i = 3:

Numerator: 1 - (1/2)^3 = 1 - 1/8 = 7/8
Denominator: 1 - (1/2)^6 = 1 - 1/64 = 63/64

P(3) = (7/8) / (63/64) = (7/8) · (64/63) = (7·64)/(8·63) = 448/504 = 8/9

Final answer: 8/9
